notes.title: Metits Magic 3: The Revenge of Luli – Official Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
The wait is almost over. Metits Magic 3: The Revenge of Luli officially launches on April 14, 2025!

Prepare to uncover the secrets of Darski High School, face terrifying foes, and survive the relentless pursuit of Big Marina. Outsmart deadly teachers, solve intricate puzzles, and brace yourself for an intense final battle against Luli himself.

Are you ready to face the Sacred Protein’s curse? Your nightmare begins April 14th.

Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3590660/Metits_Magic_3_The_Revenge_Of_Luli/?beta=0

notes.title: Metits Magic 3: The Curse Of The Sacred Protein Official Announcement
notes.content:
🕯️ ANNOUNCEMENT: Metits Magic 3 – The Curse Of The Sacred Protein 🕯️

A new horror adventure is coming… but not everything is as it seems.

DreamWave Interactive is proud to unveil Metits Magic 3: The Curse Of The Sacred Protein, an eerie and immersive experience that will test your mind, your instincts, and your grip on reality. Darkness lingers in every corner, and the secrets hidden within this world demand to be uncovered—whether you are ready or not.

Prepare yourself for an unsettling journey where every choice matters. Metits Magic 3 will launch exclusively on PC (Steam), delivering a terrifying experience unlike anything before.

📅 Release Window: Mid-April to Early May 2025
🖥️ Platform: PC (Steam)

More details will be revealed soon. Until then… tread carefully. Some things are best left undiscovered.

#MetitsMagic3 #HorrorAdventure #DreamWaveInteractive

notes.title: The Nova War | Operation Dawn
notes.content:
After much consideration, we decided to change the name from The Nova War to Operation Dawn, therefore it was decided to change the full story of the game and it will take about a month but because we decided to publish the full game and not for early access, Operation Dawn will not be released until mid 2025 or late 2025. These considerations were decided in order to guarantee the player the best experience that DreamWave Interactive can produce.
We are very sorry for this update and we promise to inform about everything related to the game, from screenshots to trailers and more...
DreamWave Interactive

notes.title: The Nova War Official Announcement
notes.content:
We are happy to announce the new game from DreamWave Interactive.
Introducing Nova War, the game follows Miles' life after terrorists break into his home and murder his son.
The game was released during 2024 in early access (not the whole story will be ready for publication).
The game will receive many updates including updates to the continuation of the story and its ending.
We are already happy to announce a DLC coming out around 2025 called The Nova War: The Day After. The game follows a girl who has lost all her family and friends and has to start life over. The DLC takes place after the events of the base game

notes.title: Skyborn Odyssey Official announcement
notes.content:
DreamWave Interactive is proud to present our next game called Skyborn Odyssey. We worked on the game for a long year and achieved a game with very good graphics and soon we will finish the beta tests, the game will be expected to cost [b]$10[/b] with discounts coming later.
We are very proud of the final product and plan to release more images from the game here or on our Twitter page.
An official trailer will be released on January 20, 2024 on DreamWave's YouTube page.
See you on the other side

notes.title: RUINED Part 2 DLC Update!!!
notes.content:
We are removing RUINED 2 from the STEAM store because the final product was not exactly what we wanted it to be.
Since the DLC was free we will not issue a refund or offer a replacement DLC for the owners, those who have already received the DLC for free are asked to delete it from the content that is downloaded together with the game.
People who do not do this will not receive anything as we are deleting from the game files the map and all the content that was in RUINED 2.
We may do something similar with RUINED 1 as well, but because the DLC cost money for the players we will not offer a refund but will offer a replacement DLC that will have an activation code for the RUINED Part 1 onwers.
Details about that later on....

notes.title: RUINED Part 2 ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
Big news on the horizon – get ready to dive back into the world of RUINED with the all-new RUINED Part 2 DLC! And guess what? It's totally free to play! We're beyond excited to share this thrilling chapter with you, packed with even more excitement, mystery, and heart-pounding adventure.

🌟 What's in Store for You:

✨ Bigger, Better Story: Brace yourselves for an epic narrative that'll keep you hooked from start to finish. RUINED Part 2 brings a whole new level of storytelling, with fresh characters, unexpected twists, and more mysteries to come.

✨ Explore New Lands: Not just one, not two, but three captivating maps are yours to explore! From old abandoned laboratory to ancient space ship, each map is a unique adventure, brimming with secrets and challenges.

✨ Innovative Game Mode: Hold onto your hats, because we're introducing an exciting new game mode that's all about pushing your skills to the limit. Get ready to experience RUINED like never before!

✨ Stunning Visuals and Audio: The world of RUINED has never looked or sounded this good. We've revamped the graphics and audio for an even more immersive experience that'll send shivers down your spine.

✨ Continuation of Your Journey: Whether you're a RUINED veteran or a first-time player, A new beginning awaits you from Part 1. Your choices matter and will shape the outcome of Part 3's gripping story.

✨ Community-Driven Improvements: We've heard your voices loud and clear and have fine-tuned RUINED Part 2 based on your feedback. This DLC is a celebration of our amazing community and your dedication to our world.

Join us on this incredible adventure as we uncover secrets, face new challenges, and embark on a quest that'll leave you wanting more. The team is overjoyed to present RUINED Part 2, and we can't wait to share the excitement with you.

Get ready to enter the ruins once again – your next great adventure awaits!

notes.title: World War 1 - Limited Time Modes Announcment
notes.content:
🚀 Introducing "World War 1 - Limited Time Modes" DLC! 🚀


Are you ready to embark on a thrilling journey through history? Get ready to dive into the trenches of World War 1 like never before! 

At the low price of just $1.99, you can access this incredible DLC and enjoy a fresh World War 1 experience each month. Don't miss out on the chance to rewrite history and prove your prowess on the battlefield.  

🌟 Key Features 🌟

🔥 New Game Modes: Immerse yourself in the chaos of World War 1 with fresh, monthly game modes. Each mode brings a unique twist to the battlefield, ensuring that no two battles are alike!

🗺️ New Maps: Get ready for big, unprecedented maps that will challenge your skills and immerse you in the epic battles of World War 1.

🎮 Enhanced Gameplay: Experience gameplay enhancements that will challenge your tactical skills and immerse you in the era's warfare. Authentic weapons, tactics, and strategies await your command.

💥 More Surprises: Uncover hidden secrets, unlock rare collectibles, and take on new challenges as you progress through the DLC. There's always something new to discover!

Prepare to rewrite the pages of history with "World War 1 - Limited Time Modes" DLC. Join us on this epic journey, and let's make history together! Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to enlist in the adventure of a lifetime. 💣🏆🌍

Stay tuned for the official release date and be sure to spread the word to your fellow gamers. It's time to conquer the past and shape the future!
